messages:
alex: quick decision needed on "mini-capture" default policy. ops wants safe-on for canaries but we need strict cost/PII guardrails.
bella: agree. default = 0.5% route-weighted sampling, tenant-hash bucketing, default profile = privacy-tight. opt-in for relaxed.
charlie: request: make quotas token-aware (tokens = recorded context tokens) not per-request. easier to reason about $$ impact.
dina: UX: console should show projected monthly cost delta, remaining token budget, and an emergency off switch. also per-route sample heatmap.
alex: what happens when tenant exceeds budget? drop capture or fallback to super-rare global sampling?
bella: fallback = 1-in-100k global trace sample + emit tag capture.reason=quota_exhausted. keep one tiny breadcrumb for debugging.
charlie: routing: route raw mini-captures to a dedicated scrubber pool (cpu constrained). store pre-scrub encrypted artefact for 15m then delete. write only redacted to long-term.
dina: audit: any unredacted view requires 2p approval + console audit entry. also KMS-wrap exported blobs and TTL=24h.
alex: enforcement: profiles-as-code in repo, linter prevents detectors=[] on prod routes. small schema example:
```
profiles:
  privacy-tight:
    detectors: [nlp-name, regex-email, regex-phone]
    keep_context: 0
  debug-lite:
    detectors: [nlp-name]
    keep_context: 64
```
bella: telemetry to emit: mini_capture.count, mini_capture.tokens.recorded, mini_capture.scrub_latency_ms, mini_capture.quota_hits. show alerts in console when projected spend > 3% tenant bill or > $1k/mo.
charlie: ops: require feature-flag rollout and canary metric watch. canary -> 5% hosts, watch mini_capture.scrub_latency_ms > 2s for paging.
deploy-bot: deploy-note: mini-capture.v0 canary started on canary-7. metrics hooks enabled.
dina: next steps: bella drafts RFC (quota + fallback), charlie adds linter + scrub-pool infra plan, alex wires console mock. timeline: RFC by Fri, mock next Wed.
alex: thanks. filing follow-ups in docs: https://go/r/mini-capture-policy
